01

Expertise

Three areas supported by research and working systems

Sensor fusion and state estimation

I fuse camera and LiDAR observations to track vehicle motion, and use IMU time series to classify forward, reverse and stationary states.

  • Camera–LiDAR processing and IMU-based state classification
  • DQN-based observation selection
  • YOLOX thermal detection and multi-object tracking
  • EKF-based IMM estimation of position, speed and heading
  • Handling occlusion and changing observation quality
20.6% lower position RMSE in field tests

Autonomous driving and motion planning

I turn perception outputs into obstacle-avoidance paths, then test planning and control integration on vehicles and in simulation.

  • Wall and obstacle separation with DBSCAN and RANSAC
  • Frenet, A* and Dynamic VO planning
  • ROS 2 vehicle integration and FSM-based avoidance
IFAC RoboRacer: round of 16 among 56 teams

Embedded and system software

I build real-time systems that connect sensors, actuators, decision logic and operator interfaces.

  • STM32 peripherals: timers, PWM and input capture
  • Five control tasks and ten message queues in FreeRTOS
  • State machines for detection, tracking and reacquisition
  • TouchGFX interfaces and UART verification
  • Hailo NPU inference and C++ preprocessing optimization
Automatic detection, tracking and reacquisition

Projects

Selected work, from the engineering problem to implementation and test results.

01
Sep 2024–Aug 2025 / Ministry of Education, NRF / Principal Investigator

Vehicle tracking with reinforcement learning and camera–LiDAR fusion

To handle occlusion and changing sensor quality, I implemented DQN-based corner selection and IMM state estimation, then validated the tracker at a real intersection.

  • 20.6% lower position RMSE in field tests
  • Master’s thesis and patent application
Project details →
02
Sep–Nov 2026 / Lead of a six-person team / Thermal data, YOLOX-S, NPU optimization, multi-object tracking

ARGUS: onboard thermal detection and tracking

Detects ground objects in thermal video and tracks the target the operator selects, all on the drone. Tested in simulation and in indoor and outdoor flights.

  • 61.3% lower detection latency on Raspberry Pi 5
  • All 31 requirements passed
Project details →
03
Jul–Aug 2026 / IFAC 2026 / LiDAR perception, Frenet planning and FSM

IFAC RoboRacer: obstacle perception and avoidance planning

I built LiDAR perception, a Frenet avoidance planner and an FSM for a ROS 2 race car. I tuned the system on the track and analyzed the localization failure after a collision.

  • Round of 16 among 56 teams
  • Tested on a ROS 2 race car
Project details →
04
Jun 2024–Aug 2025 / Government-funded research / State-classification module

IMU-based driving-state classification with LSTM and FSM

To classify motion without internal vehicle signals, I combined LSTM transition detection with an FSM for forward, reverse and stationary states.

  • Average F1-score: 99.50%
  • Co-author, Measurement (2026)
